integrity: Self-contained analytic proof of angular monotonicity and batch law; standalone finite checks are corroborative, not a proof for all parameters. Only self-review performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem only for fixed nonzero starts in dimension two, positive-definite quadratic objectives and Gaussian SPD covariance, independent candidate directions, exact line minimization, and best-of-batch selection. No sequential or joint-span iteration claim. Specialized publication-priority overlap remains possible.
title: An exact all-threshold minimax law and square-root batch budget for planar Gaussian random-line descent
